meta.title: Whale Girl · Merged Card
meta.description: Frosted-glass status bubble beside the whale girl: balance ¥, today ¥, cache hit rate and peak/off-peak (this-turn spend on hover), plus cache-hit / output / cache-miss charge danmaku. Ctrl+Alt+D shows the original damage-pulse card. Data merges dsh-damage-pulse and dsh-whale-widget.
